english: When for the holy Trinity, Father and Son and Holy Spirit, the true God, we proclaim
we begin to write the book of the Chronography that is composed of the writings of the sons (of men):
which I composed for Mar Gregory, the Maphrian,
the light of the East and of the West,
who is Abu'l-Faraj, son of Aaron the physician, of Melitene, the city {OCR?}
and is called Bar 'Ebraya.
The first helper {OCR?}.
God, help my weakness.
Blessed are You, O Lord and Master of all creatures and of the upright ones,
You are the First and You are the Last.
And to You every rebellion is reconciled {OCR?},
and to You every confession is due,
and to the Son, the Word of the power of Your wisdom,
and to the Holy Spirit, the life of Your existence,
from eternity, now, and forever.
And because of this life, this word was created, to make known the being of its praise and the goodness of its ... {OCR?}
and to make known, from the first reckoning, the place of the theoretical (astronomical tables) {OCR?},
and to show that the two (branches) of hearing are the excellent practical (arts) {OCR?},
the attendants of the ... of Baghdad and of the good and the evil ministered {OCR?},
more abundant than all the small dwellings of those who in goodness gather to acquire,
and in evil they add to hatred.

and the lies of the Second (party) to shake the ... {OCR?},
